Fixed in commit **[CENSORED!] Links to external GitHub repositories are not allowed** — `EnableModelessKeyboardInterop` is now wrapped in try-catch. The WPF `PresentationSource` may not be initialized when the splash screen thread starts, causing a `NullReferenceException` deep inside the WPF interop layer.
